message.content:
A linen-blend blazer with a relaxed fit, mid-length hemline, and a soft sandy beige color (#e3d5c6), crafted from lightweight breathable fabric.
A high-waisted wide-leg trouser in dark wash denim, full-length leg opening, and a deep charcoal grey tone (#2f3136), made of structured stretch cotton.
Simple gold-tone stud earrings with small discs, finished in polished brass metal.
A classic pointed-toe loafer, medium heel height, and the same sandy beige color (#e3d5c6), constructed from smooth leather.

This outfit bridges the gap between a relaxed beach day and an elegant evening meal on the promenade. The linen-blend blazer provides a touch of sophistication suitable for artificial light while remaining comfortable in autumn air temperatures. Pairing it with dark denim trousers balances the formality without feeling too stiff for a vacation setting. Completing the look with gold studs and beige loafers ties the color palette together, allowing you to move freely from sand to seaside dining with effortless style.
